```php
<?php

namespace App\Policies;

use App\Models\User;
use App\Models\Relation;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\HandlesAuthorization;

class RelationPolicy extends HandlesAuthorization
{
    public function viewAny(User $user)
    {
        return true; // Allow all users to view relations
    }

    public function view(User $user, Relation $relation)
    {
        return true; // Allow all users to view a specific relation
    }

    public function create(User $user)
    {
        return true; // Allow all users to create relations
    }

    public function update(User $user, Relation $relation)
    {
        return true; // Allow all users to update a specific relation
    }

    public function delete(User $user, Relation $relation)
    {
        return true; // Allow all users to delete a specific relation
    }
}
```
